mapper.select: SELECT a.paper_id, a.paper_name, a.category_id, a.total_score, a.duration, a.create_date, sc.category_name FROM exam_paper a LEFT JOIN source_category sc on sc.category_id = a.category_id
SELECT quest_id, paper_id, quest_type, opt_layout, quest_content, quest_no, have_img, img_name, score FROM exam_quest WHERE paper_id = #{paperId} ORDER BY quest_no, quest_id
SELECT o.opt_id, o.quest_id, o.opt_cont, o.img_name, o.is_correct FROM exam_quest_opt o INNER JOIN exam_quest q ON q.quest_id = o.quest_id WHERE q.paper_id = #{paperId} ORDER BY o.opt_id
